title: Fix Parent Connection Lookup For Fix Piece
description: Fix Piece no-op: findParentConnectionForPieceInDesign passed parent piece id into findConnectionInDesign which expects a connection guid. Align design app transaction hook with sketchpadStore.designApp fallback.
summary: Fixed findParentConnectionForPieceInDesign to select the incident connection whose other endpoint is parentPieceId (metadata parent is a piece guid, not a connection guid). useDesignAppTransaction now falls back to sketchpadStore.designApp(kitScope, designScope) when useDesignStore is null. Added vitest in compose/js for Nakagin child+fixPieceInDesign. Files: compose/js/index.ts, compose/sketchpad/index.tsx.
